The '''Primordial blaster''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used around the time of the [[Galactic War]]<ref name="TOR" /> and the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:DAR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=weekly|Daily Area: Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

Primordial blasters were used by [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] of the Third Galactic War,<ref name="TOR:DAR" /> including [[Rubassa]].<ref name="TOR:TSL">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=heroic|The Strongest Links|Ruhnuk}}</ref>
